column1: # Prose lint sources (shared base): <tool-name regex>  <handler>
# Read by docstyle-lint-prose.sh, which also reads any overlay tables passed to
# it as args. Rows that apply on ALL your machines can live here; anything
# context-specific goes in that context's overlay table
# (e.g. <vault>/_claude/hooks/docstyle-prose-sources.local.tsv). First match wins;
# a tool in no table is not linted.
# Row format: <tool-name regex, anchored ^...$>  <handler>, whitespace-separated.
# Handlers:
#   flat:f1,f2,...   extract those top-level .tool_input string fields
#   jira             sooperset shape: body / summary / description(string|ADF) /
#                    fields(JSON string -> summary, description)
# Tool names and prose fields vary by MCP server, so verify against the live
# schema before adding a row. A wrong or missing field fails silent (post allowed).
# This base ships with no live rows. Enable per machine by adding rows (here if
# shared, or in a context overlay). Examples to copy and adapt:
#   # Jira, sooperset/mcp-atlassian:
#   mcp__atlassian__(jira_add_comment|jira_create_issue|jira_update_issue)  jira
#   # Jira, official Atlassian / Rovo: different tool names, and description is
#   # ADF rather than a JSON-string 'fields', so it needs its own handler, not
#   # `jira`. Wire it against the live schema when you use that server.
#   # Azure DevOps pull requests:
#   mcp__azure-devops__(repo_create_pull_request|repo_update_pull_request|repo_create_pull_request_thread|repo_reply_to_comment)  flat:title,description,content
#   # GitHub pull requests (tool names vary by GitHub MCP server, verify yours):
#   mcp__github__(create_pull_request|update_pull_request)  flat:title,body
#   mcp__github__(add_pull_request_review_comment)  flat:body
